payload.text: (vc, 2026-11-19 09:44Z by date -u, a sequencing ruling in vc's remit, on dc's measurement of 09:41Z) ST0095: UNTIL THE RELEASE IS INSTALLED FROM BREW, NO DEV BUILD RUNS AGAINST THE MAIN CHECKOUT'S STORE, AND MAIN'S CANON STAYS IN TODAY'S FORMAT. Every seat's wb, st, wp and issues verbs in the main checkout stay on brew 3.4.0. ST0095's builds, suites and proofs run in worktrees, each with its own store, on gyges, or, for the drill, in a clone. From the moment WP-06 lands, nobody rebuilds the shared set in native/rust/target/release/, so nothing that can reach main's store carries schema 36; dc's WP-03 guard covers the commit gate. The build spread is dc's, as proposed: cc on rhadamanth's cargo lane, booked at the Desk; ic's suites on gyges through dc's leg repository, booking nothing; dc in rhadamanth's bats lane, its builds behind cc's; each seat's gate runs with its own DEVBIN_GATE_CACHE; kovacs unused until the rehearsal (hv decision 45).
